data.current_description:
Validates an address against Lumen systems and returns the __serviceAddress__ in [USPS fielded format](https://faq.usps.com/s/article/What-is-the-Format-and-Sequence-of-Information-for-the-Recipient-s-Address).

__Required fields:__
```
streetAddress
streetNumber
streetNumberSuffix
preDirectional
streetName
postDirectional
streetSuffix
city
state
zipCode
country
```
data.summary_suggestion: Validate and standardize service address to USPS format
data.description_suggestion: Validates a service address against Lumen systems and returns the standardized address in USPS fielded format. This operation is typically used before ordering or porting telephone numbers to ensure address accuracy and compliance. Accepts a complete address with all required fields (streetAddress, streetNumber, streetNumberSuffix, preDirectional, streetName, postDirectional, streetSuffix, city, state, zipCode, country). Returns the validated and formatted ServiceAddressResponseBody. Address validation may correct minor formatting issues or reject invalid addresses that do not match Lumen's systems.
